name: fair-trial
description: Fair Trial: a concept for Be Bodywise (Mosaic Fellowship Builder Challenge). Phone web app + one Cloudflare Pages Function.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck:functions && npm run build -w app
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck:functions
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
